item.unique.uniq-tollkeeper-bill.lore.1: Recovered from the burned toll house at Sunken Ford.
item.unique.uniq-tollkeeper-bill.lore.2: Collector Vance kept his books in ink until raiders came, and in marrow after.
item.unique.uniq-bren-dry-boot.lore.1: Scout Bren swore he lost its twin in the willow sinks east of Ravenwatch.
item.unique.uniq-bren-dry-boot.lore.2: In truth, he traded it for three dry biscuits and a lying map.
item.unique.uniq-mordred-tallow-wand.lor: Bleached alder dipped in crypt tallow that lights where dry kindling fails.
item.unique.uniq-ravenwatch-gate-door.lo: Iron-oak pried from Ravenwatch's portcullis, still studded with arrowheads.
item.unique.uniq-greywood-poacher-bow.lo: Confiscated from Greywood poachers, then reissued to shoot anything in furs.
item.unique.uniq-krag-jawbone.lore: Weighted with chipped granite from a troll's knee; unsubtle and persuasive.
item.unique.uniq-corin-dispatch-ring.lor: Courier Corin swallowed this signet twice at Lantern Passage to save his orders.
item.unique.uniq-undervault-lantern-helm: A bound marsh-wisp inside the crest shrieks whenever mine air turns sour.
item.unique.uniq-morvessa-spindle.lore: Cut from Morvessa's calcified silk-gland; still clammy in damp weather.
item.unique.uniq-alkali-canteen-amulet.l: Tastes of rust and dead beetles, yet men killed for a sip at Highgate Watch.
item.unique.uniq-kaelen-marrow-needle.lo: Hexer Kaelen claimed bloodletting cured enemy soldiers of standing upright.
item.unique.uniq-quarry-overseer-maul.lo: Its iron-wrapped haft still bears the convict leader's quarry serial number.
item.unique.uniq-wardstone-shard-focus.l: Chipped from the north monolith; smells of scorched sand and static storm.
item.unique.uniq-bram-axle-shield.lore: Quartermaster Bram strapped leather to a broken wagon wheel and called it armor.
item.unique.uniq-vorn-retreat-boots.lore: Vorn's officers called it a rout; his memoirs called it rearward realignment.
item.unique.uniq-embalmer-linen-robe.lor: Bitumen-soaked burial cloth that keeps out rot if kept far from open flame.
item.unique.uniq-mirage-hunters-bow.lore: Sinew-cured horn that makes archers hallucinate cold ale along the arrow-shelf.
item.unique.uniq-gorrathul-gizzard-stone: Hacked from Gorrathul's third stomach beside six buckles and a guild signet.
item.unique.uniq-sera-bone-saw.lore: Bite the leather strap; dying of shock beats dying of marsh gangrene.
Worn by a castellan who refused to leave even after winter tides took the floor.
Oakhaven's baron kept this second seal solely to siphon garrison pensions.
item.unique.uniq-lyra-last-arbalest.lore: When cedar bolts ran dry, Warden Lyra's crew loaded iron hinges and jail keys.
Drop-forged to turn rusted canal gears; it turns helmets with equal leverage.
item.unique.uniq-stormtree-amber-staff.l: Charred coastal heartwood that never stopped burning, only waited for a target.
item.unique.uniq-admiral-kael-spyglass.l: Heat-cracked brass lenses that still reckon broadside arcs with cruel precision.
item.unique.uniq-drowned-choir-bell.lore: Salvaged from the flooded nave; it still swings in rhythm with coastal tides.
item.unique.uniq-vesperion-organ-pipe.lo: A bone pipe from Vesperion's organ whose flat F-sharp makes watchdogs weep.
Malrik's neat Collegium notes degenerate into frantic caldera diagrams.
item.unique.uniq-rowan-siege-helm.lore: Dented by a basalt stone at Greystone; Rowan claimed it improved his posture.
item.unique.uniq-anvilmaw-slag-maul.lore: Still cherry-red at the core; it chars oak tables before the ale goes flat.
item.unique.uniq-redglass-fletched-bow.l: Ribbed with crimson obsidian that slices bare fingers on a careless draw.
item.unique.uniq-gauntlet-pacifier-shiel: Its bearer died wedged upright in the pass so his company could climb over.
item.unique.uniq-penitent-cinder-boots.l: Forged without leather linings so soldiers in lava trenches never stopped marching.
item.unique.uniq-hollow-monarch-blade.lo: Coronation steel with its royal crest chiseled off; cuts like a broken treaty.
item.unique.uniq-threshold-scales-ring.l: One half set in cold silver, the other in slag from the Obsidian Dais.
item.unique.uniq-ashkarath-crown-shard.l: A molten horn-tip from Ashkarath's halo that pulls toward the earth's core.
item.unique.uniq-fen-poacher-yew.lore: Silent draw wrapped in oiled otter-pelt for wet reed-beds.
item.unique.uniq-tollkeeper-prod.lore: Horn-tipped limbs notched for exact bridge-post distance markers.
item.unique.uniq-bracken-stalker-bow.lor: Sinew-backed limbs lacquered thick against Redmarsh squalls.
item.unique.uniq-harbor-winch-arbalest.l: Heavy steel prod stamped with Oakhaven's customs anchor.
item.unique.uniq-caldera-gale-bow.lore: Six-foot stave whose string hums in rising volcanic updrafts.
item.unique.uniq-peat-cowl.lore: Dyed in dark bog-tannin to vanish against rain-soaked reeds.
item.unique.uniq-viper-scale-jerkin.lore: Cured desert serpent hide riveted with tarnished brass studs.
item.unique.uniq-gorse-brigandine.lore: Crimson sail-canvas lined inside with spring-steel lames.
item.unique.uniq-drake-wing-cloak.lore: Pebbled redglass drake hide that sheds furnace sparks like rain.
item.unique.uniq-wyrm-stalker-mail.lore: Iridescent caldera scales bound tight with dried wyrm-sinew.
item.unique.uniq-bog-treads.lore: Soft elkhide soles stitched to leave no print in wet river clay.
item.unique.uniq-gale-striders.lore: Wing-stamped scout boots light as dried gull feathers.
item.unique.uniq-string-slap-bracer.lore: Grooved ox-horn armguard polished smooth by a thousand releases.
item.unique.uniq-night-blade-grips.lore: Pitch-dark kidskin gloves hiding lead-weighted knuckles.
item.unique.uniq-glass-eye-mask.lore: Steeped ebon hide fitted with a smoked-quartz assay monocle.
item.unique.uniq-quarry-dusk-dirk.lore: Narrow off-hand poignard built for finishing pinned quarrymen.
item.unique.uniq-parish-probate-wand.lor: Notched along the shaft with forty-seven unpaid pauper-liens.
item.unique.uniq-salt-yew-rod.lore: Graveyard yew heartwood rubbed dry with sea-salt and hearth-ash.
item.unique.uniq-amber-debt-wand.lore: A preserved bog-beetle gleams inside its fossilized resin knob.
item.unique.uniq-ossuary-siphon.lore: Hexagonal quartz darkened by decades of ossuary incense soot.
item.unique.uniq-first-watch-archon.lore: Inlaid with tarnished brass rings stamped with First Watch numbers.
item.unique.uniq-abbey-censer-staff.lore: Charred at the ferrule from swinging heavy iron abbey censers.
item.unique.uniq-pale-gallows-staff.lore: Coiled ash roots that tighten slightly near freshly spilled blood.
item.unique.uniq-mortuary-cassock.lore: Threadbare black wool patched at the hem with pauper-roll linen.
item.unique.uniq-copper-stole-robe.lore: Loomed with fine copper threads to bleed off stray ley static.
item.unique.uniq-embalmer-shroud.lore: Treated with funerary bitumen to repel marsh rot and vermin.
item.unique.uniq-velvet-arbiter-mantle.l: Heavy burgundy pile trimmed with ash-grey coastal wolf fur.
item.unique.uniq-star-testament-robe.lor: Stitched with silver thread tracing forgotten Anchor constellations.
item.unique.uniq-ink-stained-wimple.lore: Folded ash-linen hood smelling faintly of oak-gall ink and sage.

item.unique.uniq-drowned-mirror.lore: Bone-framed silver disc pitted by years of Oakhaven harbor brine.
item.unique.uniq-knuckle-tally-ring.lore: Carved from a yellow knucklebone stamped with a bailiff's mark.
item.unique.uniq-alder-gate-cleaver.lore: Notched broadsword ground bright on wet river flagstones.
item.unique.uniq-quarry-breaker-maul.lor: Iron-banded ash haft wedged tight with fractured quarry steel.
item.unique.uniq-vanguard-flamberge.lore: Undulating siege blade darkened permanently with caldera soot.
item.unique.uniq-ironheart-executioner.l: Square-tipped greatsword stamped with Gorrathul's dry-well tallies.
item.unique.uniq-ashkarath-zweihander.lo: Six feet of meteoric star-iron weeping banked caldera ember.
item.unique.uniq-ravenwatch-pavise.lore: Scorched oak planks bolted onto plates of meteoric slag.
item.unique.uniq-ironcamp-gothic.lore: Rippled black steel quenched in Ironcamp's sulfur brine.
item.unique.uniq-rowan-basinet.lore: Dented nasal bar scarred by hot caldera catapult shrapnel.
item.unique.uniq-collegium-ash-staff.lor: Inlaid runes copied from banned thermodynamic conduit diagrams.
item.unique.uniq-mint-assayer-staff.lore: Ashwood shaft wound tight with galvanic Border Mint copper wire.
item.unique.uniq-wardstone-quartz.lore: Milky crystal core humming at a teeth-rattling telluric pitch.
item.unique.uniq-astral-nav-sphere.lore: Salt-corroded brass rings locked due south toward the straits.
item.unique.uniq-cosmos-caldera-eye.lore: Slit-pupiled gem floating coldly inside blackened threshold gold.
item.unique.uniq-oakhaven-wire-hat.lore: Midnight felt lined inside with copper grounding wire.
item.unique.uniq-conclave-diadem.lore: Interlocking silver crescents cradling a cold, unflawed diamond.
item.unique.uniq-galvanic-channelers.lor: Crimson velvet gloves stitched with grounded brass eyelets.
item.unique.uniq-alder-bridge-pike.lore: Notched along the spine from parrying raider boarding axes.
item.unique.uniq-mill-wheel-shield.lore: Swollen oak mill boards banded with an iron wagon-tire.
item.unique.uniq-ford-wader-greaves.lore: Triple-greased hide that sheds cold creek-water like duck down.
item.unique.uniq-willow-snare-bow.lore: Twisted sinew cord rubbed with beeswax against morning river mist.
item.unique.uniq-briar-stalker-hood.lore: Stitched from briar-hound hide so thick blackthorns slide off.
item.unique.uniq-ferryman-gloves.lore: Calloused river-hide molded to the curve of a punt-pole and bow.
item.unique.uniq-hedge-clerk-rod.lore: Carved with survey notches that glow faintly near ley-water.
item.unique.uniq-tallow-candle-focus.lor: Bubbled river-sand glass that splits a single spark into three.
item.unique.uniq-peat-smoke-cowl.lore: Wide felt brim stiffened with river-clay and old candle wax.
item.unique.uniq-creek-bone-wand.lore: Peeled river-willow bound with yellowed catgut and fish-bones.
item.unique.uniq-pauper-burial-robe.lore: Hemmed with coarse hemp twine and dusted with parish quicklime.
item.unique.uniq-knuckle-dice-ring.lore: Whittled from a sheep's knucklebone found under the Crooked Willow.
item.unique.uniq-bog-iron-cleaver.lore: Pitted dark bog-iron that holds a jagged edge in wet peat.
item.unique.uniq-sunken-warden-plate.lor: Every iron link boiled in pine-pitch to keep black rot out.
item.unique.uniq-peat-trench-shield.lore: Slotted near the top so a pikeman can thrust without peeking.
item.unique.uniq-reed-whistle-bow.lore: Laminated horn limbs wrapped in mottled plague-toad skin.
item.unique.uniq-leech-hunter-boots.lore: Soles pegged with bog-oak spikes that bite cleanly into slick peat.
item.unique.uniq-bog-fog-mask.lore: Fine horsehair mesh sewn over the mouth to filter marsh-gas.
item.unique.uniq-wisp-lantern-staff.lore: A rusted iron cage at the tip traps a shivering marsh-flame.

item.unique.uniq-wormwood-robe.lore: Stitched with dried wormwood pockets that rattle on the march.
item.unique.uniq-peat-marrow-wand.lore: Blackened bog-yew inlaid with a sliver of cracked bell-metal.
item.unique.uniq-bog-mummy-wraps.lore: Linen strips pickled dark brown by centuries under acidic peat.
item.unique.uniq-carrion-talisman.lore: Tarnished bronze enclosing a tiny skull carved from marsh-chalk.

item.unique.uniq-gale-wall-kite.lore: Curved steel face hammered with Oakhaven's storm-lashed beacon.
item.unique.uniq-corsair-wind-bow.lore: Backed with cured shark-skin that refuses to stretch in sea-fog.
item.unique.uniq-cliff-talon-grips.lore: Striped with brass salvaged from a sunken royal pay-frigate.
item.unique.uniq-salt-spray-striders.lor: Braided hemp soles stitched over calfskin for wet kelp-rocks.
item.unique.uniq-storm-beacon-staff.lore: Charred driftwood spiral-carved with copper lightning-rods.
item.unique.uniq-brine-mirror-focus.lore: Hollow sea-glass orb half-filled with swirling, glowing brine.
item.unique.uniq-abyssal-velvet-robe.lor: Salt-stiffened indigo velvet stitched with silver wave-knots.
item.unique.uniq-whalebone-siphon.lore: Polished sea-amber capped with a shard of leviathan tooth.
item.unique.uniq-barnacle-skull-cowl.lor: Gray sailcloth weighted at the hem with pitted lead sinkers.
item.unique.uniq-drowned-gold-signet.lor: Corroded sea-gold stamped with a broken oar and chained skull.
item.unique.uniq-cinder-throne-greatswor: Wave-bladed steel quenched in boiling oil and brazier-soot.
item.unique.uniq-slag-forged-plate.lore: Fluted dark steel layered with mica plates against crown-fire.
item.unique.uniq-sovereign-aegis.lore: Heavy bronze-rimmed tower face scarred by molten slag splashes.
item.unique.uniq-obsidian-greatbow.lore: Steel-backed limbs inlaid with razor splinters of volcanic glass.
item.unique.uniq-ash-wind-mask.lore: Smoked-glass eye-lenses set into blackened, soot-proofed hide.
item.unique.uniq-cinder-stalker-gloves.l: Supple salamander-hide palms that never blister on hot iron.
item.unique.uniq-star-forge-staff.lore: Crowned with a glowing coal from the First King's own hearth.
item.unique.uniq-cosmos-ember-lens.lore: Cast from the melted bronze of Oakhaven's great cathedral bell.

item.unique.uniq-chancellery-siphon-wand: Charred bone shaft capped with compressed chancellery soot.
item.unique.uniq-crown-ossuary-diadem.lo: Blackened iron circlet set with dull, heat-cracked bloodstones.
item.unique.uniq-sovereign-pyre-medallio: Heavy slab of vitrified slag pulsing with trapped, dying warmth.

item.set.set-thornwick-picket.muster_rol: Stamped on the collar with a picket number long struck off the roll.

item.set.set-oakhaven-arbalest.signal_sp: Slitted leather hood shielding eyes from beacon-glare and soot.
item.set.set-oakhaven-arbalest.seawall_g: Studded cuffs that steady heavy arbalest stocks on wet stone.
